data.one_liner: A lightweight, no‑dependency DI library for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides scoped, singleton and transient references with simple override and automatic disposal support. Uses top‑level variables for fast lookups and safe error handling.
use_when: You need a minimal DI solution without code generation.
You want easy testing via overrides in widget sub‑trees.
You prefer a small API surface and no extra package dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a large ecosystem of plugins and integrations.
strengths: Zero external dependencies, keeping the app size small.
Simple API that’s easy to learn.
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to more mature DI containers.
No code‑generation support for compile‑time safety.
Smaller community and fewer third‑party extensions.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, feature‑rich DI container with extensive community support.

alternatives.name: injector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar lightweight DI with a slightly different API.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers compile‑time code generation for type‑safe injection if you need that.
